name: Craft
summary: Notes and productivity app with docs, tasks, calendar, whiteboards and AI across devices.
description: Craft is a notes and productivity app with documents, tasks, calendar, whiteboards and daily notes that syncs across devices. The Free plan covers occasional use; Plus costs $8 per month ($6.40 billed yearly), and a Family plan costs $15 per month. Use cases shown include meeting notes, social media posts and shoot plans. Its documents, tasks and calendar are combined in one space.
